tooltips.isDefault: If checked, this funnel will be automatically selected for new opportunities within the team
tooltips.followupsEnabled: When disabled, opportunities in this funnel never run automated follow-ups: the AI does not schedule follow-up timers on new opportunities, scheduled follow-ups stop firing, and any active follow-ups in this funnel have their timer cleared (becoming 'Follow-up Inactive' while preserving the sent count) the moment you disable it. The AI can still create and update opportunities in this funnel normally.
